text: The gap between knowing and doing is where most organisations live.
AI can give you the answers, but it can't give you the understanding.
Complexity is easy. Clarity is the hard part.
Transformation is not a project. It's a decision.
Technology is only as good as the decision it enables.
You learn more from shipping something broken than planning something perfect.
Most digital transformations fail not because of technology. But because of people.
The best technology disappears. It just works.
point out the good when you see it. in life, in others, in yourself.
author: Topher Kearby
